what: Named Return to Pitch: wander is allowed; return is a file, a commit, or a halt.
why: A loop that never returns catechizes attachment. Selection is the work.
moved: Process named. Stop sits beside Plant. Night refinement without a return is refused.
mystery: The public process vault is still empty, so the night log has no public home yet.

what: Took Salim Ismail's line — Goodhart's law suddenly has agents — as the problem a human-owned constraint layer answers.
why: If agents optimize whatever they can measure, the scarce thing is judgment that travels across models — not another frontend.
moved: Public-safe one-pager drafted. A YouTube comment received a personal reply: Great to hear this.
mystery: Whether an AMA question is the next honest step without turning into a stack tour.

what: Locked the doctrine: the interface is disposable; markdown judgment is the layer that hops from model to model.
why: Many private screens hid the work. The value is not the vendor chat.
moved: Handoff and the five grains stay the portable install. UI is a face, not the OS.
mystery: How thin a public install page can stay without becoming a product tour.

what: Folded scattered private interfaces into one Garden-style desk using the same nautical star as the public site.
why: The system could not be shown because homes multiplied and the mark was wrong.
moved: One private control plane. Public face stays the github.io orchard. Discovery Desk as a separate app retired.
mystery: Whether the desk remains the only private UI when the next tool arrives.

what: Rejected a 1–5 neighbor skill scale for how the public face should speak.
why: Honest literacy is tone and age of speech, not a score that infers a person.
moved: Direction locked: rewrite the face per literacy. Do not ship five live sites yet.
mystery: The first honest public literacy door that is not a quiz.

what: Named the job line: I tell stories with data.
why: Equal depth in data and storytelling is the work, regardless of interface.
moved: The line now sits on the public thinking and on the private desk hero.
mystery: Whether a mirrored tag — data with stories — earns a public lock.

what: Voice through Grok planted a public garden seed: Hello — I made it to the public garden.
why: Needed a live example that spoken intent can land in the public repo without a scavenger hunt.
moved: First card written into garden-public.json from this pipe. The garden splash will show it after Pages rebuilds.
mystery: Formalize intake, review, and unveil so this is a habit, not a trick.

what: Backfilled Seer Chronicle for 11–12 Sep after the public trail had stopped at 9 Sep.
why: The Chronicle agent is not a background daemon. Stamps land when a model writes them and they are pushed.
moved: Seven owner-affirmed public beats added for return-to-pitch, Goodhart/agents, interface doctrine, one desk, literacy tone, stories-with-data, and the voice plant.
mystery: How Chronicle stays current without pretending it ingests itself.
